byte_determinism.note: Trivially identical: it never batched, so there was nothing to diverge.

finding: Flat at ~306 tok/s from batch 1 to 64, CV under 0.6%. mlx_lm.server serializes generation; it does not continuous-batch. The earlier 'transport failure' diagnosis was wrong twice over: mlx_lm already uses ThreadingHTTPServer, and the real cause was the 5-connection listen backlog. With the backlog raised the requests all land and are simply served one at a time. Whether MLX the LIBRARY can batch (it exposes batch_generate) is untested here.
